description: Deck tile for step-06-bolt (1920x1000 = the 8x8 tile) (Piraguas de Marisol). bolt.new, factual flow: Marisol's 11-word notes are typed; the cursor goes to the + at the input's BOTTOM-LEFT (IPR gold ring + soft pulse, callout 'Click + then Enhance prompt'); + opens a small menu (Attach file / Enhance prompt); 'Enhance prompt' is ringed and clicked; the menu closes, a 0.5s gold shimmer clears the notes and the 62-word spec streams in ('Enhancing…' then 'Enhanced'). Summary row 'Your notes · 11 words → A real spec · 62 words' (52px) always on screen, lit when the stream ends; end state holds ~3.5s, hard cut back to the empty box. No Chloé, no heading. Poster = finished spec (frame 285). Encoded: H.264 High crf 18 yuv420p limited range BT.709 +faststart; VP9 crf 32 yuv420p limited range BT.709 (full-range yuvj VP9 caused PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE in Chrome when a second clip decoded in the same page). Fixer r3: the pointer glides in above the toolbar row and drops onto the +, the callout sits 48px further right and bows out as the menu opens, so the cursor never covers 'Click + then Enhance prompt'. R9 (2026-09-27): the '+' is a drawn SVG plus on the exact centre of a border-box 64px circle (was a Montserrat/fallback glyph in a content-box 70px circle, so glyph, circle and gold ring were off-centre); re-rendered with Montserrat loaded; encode tags explicit: -vf scale full->tv range, bt601->bt709 matrix, -color_range tv -colorspace/primaries/trc bt709, level 4.0. R9 fixer 2: the word counter is singular at one word ('1 word' / 'N words'); all clips remuxed so primaries/transfer/matrix all read bt709 (range tv). PDF polish (2026-09-27): print-only poster prompt-enhance-print.jpg = Remotion still frame 92 (cursor on the + with the gold ring and the 'Click + then Enhance prompt' callout); the screen poster stays frame 285.

Deck tile for step-07-arena (1920x884 = the 9x8 tile, no letterbox) (Piraguas de Marisol). Opening beat (0-5s): the arena.ai mode dropdown 'Choose mode' is ringed (gold + pulse), opened, and 'Side by side' is picked; then Model A's picker -> gemini-3.8-flash-high and Model B's picker -> Claude-sonnet-5-high (each ringed). From 5s the race (unchanged): both type the same 4 lines of HTML (42px mono), code fades before the preview wipes up, 'Draft 2' / 'Draft 3' chips, page scrolls to the flavors. The last 0.7s fades back to the unset opening state. No Chloé. Deck: REMOVE data-start="0.9" (the clip now starts on the setup beat). Poster = both previews (frame 250). Encoded: H.264 High crf 18 yuv420p limited range BT.709 +faststart; VP9 crf 32 yuv420p limited range BT.709 (full-range yuvj VP9 caused PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE in Chrome when a second clip decoded in the same page). Fixer r2: the two model pickers appear only once 'Side by side' is set (the mode menu never half-covers them), the picker pill is a fixed 400px so the gold ring never crosses 'Choose a model', and the placeholder fades out before the model name fades in. R9 (2026-09-27): re-encoded from the same master with explicit full->tv range conversion + BT.709 tags. ROOT CAUSE of 'does not play': the old WebM was full-range (color_range=pc, bt470bg) VP9; in real Chrome, once prompt-enhance (slide 12) had decoded, arena-battle.webm failed with PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE (MEDIA_ERR_DECODE 3), currentTime stuck at 0 on the poster, and a decode error never falls back to the MP4 <source>. deck-c.js now also drops the WebM and reloads the MP4 on any decode error. R9 fixer 2: remuxed (stream copy) so colour primaries / transfer / matrix all read bt709, range tv.

Deck tile for example-2 (Piraguas de Marisol). ONE draft at a time, 0.87s each (fixer r2: shorter carousel so the live Stitch-dark pick holds ~6.3s, 45% of the loop), each screenshot pushes in from the right at full width (object-fit cover, whole-pixel steps, no edge strip); the caption hard-cuts at the push midpoint (never two captions at once): tool name first (68px), "Draft N of 5" beneath in Montserrat Medium, Light Blue (no eyebrow). Then all five with the crown on 5, 5 grows into the live site at piraguasdemarisol.site (fun ending, matches slide 21) with a LIVE! sticker. No Chloé. Re-encoded 2026-09-26 (same pixels). Encoded: H.264 High crf 18 yuv420p limited range BT.709 +faststart; VP9 crf 32 yuv420p limited range BT.709 (full-range yuvj VP9 caused PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE in Chrome when a second clip decoded in the same page). Fixer r4: the '5 drafts. Pick one.' grid is centred vertically under its title, the title fades as the pick grows, and the address only types once the site fills the tile. R9 fixer 2: remuxed (stream copy) so colour primaries / transfer / matrix all read bt709, range tv. R10 (2026-09-27): the Stitch light / Stitch dark drafts end on a clean edge under the hero (source y 1036, page colour below), so no half-cut Flavors row shows at the bottom; re-rendered from IprTileLive and encoded yuv420p tv range BT.709 (H.264 High crf 18 L4.0 +faststart, VP9 crf 32); poster moved to frame 319 (live site, Flavors + Where & When whole, clean bottom edge). R11 (2026-09-27): poster moved to frame 244, a resting frame (scroll at rest, frames 241-249) at the top of the live site: nav, the whole hero headline 'Shaved ice, the old San Juan way', LIVE! sticker and the full Flavors row; the old frame 319 was caught mid-scroll with an orphan 'way' headline line at the top. Rendered as a Remotion still (IprTileLive --frame=244), JPEG q2.

Deck tile for step-11-publish (1920x1142 = the 7x8 tile at grid-area 5/6/13/13). The Claude desktop app (IPR skin): empty chat 'How can I help?'; the prompt 'Publish the website in this folder to GitHub Pages…' (the slide's copy block, cut short with an ellipsis) is pasted (gold 'Pasted!' flash) and sent; Claude replies 'On it. Here’s what I’m doing:' and works through three steps, each spinner -> mint checkmark: Create a repository (yourname.github.io), Upload your website files (index.html + images), Turn on GitHub Pages (Settings → Pages → main); 'Your site is live: yourname.github.io' chip; the cursor clicks it and Marisol's site opens over HTTPS with a LIVE badge, confetti and a 'You’re live!' sticker (~3.5s hold); fades back to the empty chat. Type 36-132px. No Chloé, no heading (the slide carries both). Poster = all three steps checked + the live link, no cursor (frame 186). Encoded: H.264 High crf 18 yuv420p limited range BT.709 +faststart; VP9 crf 32 yuv420p limited range BT.709 (full-range yuvj VP9 caused PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE in Chrome when a second clip decoded in the same page). Fixer r4: the payoff row 'Your site is live:' (52px) + a mint pill with the URL at 60px (820x106, soft pop + glow ring) is centred in the band between the steps and the composer; the pointer only enters after the chip lands. R9 fixer 2: remuxed (stream copy) so colour primaries / transfer / matrix all read bt709, range tv.

Deck tile for step-11-publish (1920x1142 = the 7x8 tile). No heading and no Chloé (the slide carries both). yourname.github.io is typed into a browser that fills the tile width (the .com belongs to the next slide); the blank new tab lasts about 1s, then the I MADE THIS! site loads over HTTPS with a LIVE badge and holds for ~75% of the loop. Under the browser: an 88px caption You’re live on the internet! and two fact cards (GitHub Pages / free hosting, HTTPS / the padlock, secure; 56px + 44px) that land by ~1s. Confetti spawns inside the frame, behind all text. R6: firework bursts land on the hero illustration's sky, clear of the mock site nav; fact cards 132px tall, bottom margin matches the right margin. SUPERSEDED on step-11-publish by publish-claude. Why it froze on 'NEW TAB': its VP9 webm was full-range (yuvj/pc); Chrome listed the webm first, hit PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE (MediaError 3) when another clip had decoded in the same page, never fell back to the mp4, and the tile stayed on frame 0 = the blank new tab. Re-encoded (same pixels). Encoded: H.264 High crf 18 yuv420p limited range BT.709 +faststart; VP9 crf 32 yuv420p limited range BT.709 (full-range yuvj VP9 caused PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE in Chrome when a second clip decoded in the same page). R9 fixer 2: remuxed (stream copy) so colour primaries / transfer / matrix all read bt709, range tv.
